subject: Corkboard note buffer and shared note store (DMCORKBD)
constraints: The receiving campaign operates its own emulator; this campaign did not start or reserve one.
The note store is shared with Note Pad and Information Center; an edit through one application is evidence about the store, not about another application's view.
Framebuffer agreement is not persistence agreement; check the store as well as the screen.

static_findings.module_dos_io: no INT 21h AH=3Dh or AH=3Fh; persistence reaches the file through Desktop service far calls

candidate_header.0x0002: unknown, zero in every observed file

static_findings.unresolved: the live buffer's runtime location and owner

experiments.title: Locate the live text buffer
experiments.hypothesis: The live note text exists in guest memory, in the accessory's segment or in a Desktop-owned buffer.
experiments.method: Start from a blank note, type a distinctive 24-character string, save with Escape, then scan guest memory for the ASCII bytes.
experiments.expected: The string appears in one contiguous region; its segment tells whether the accessory or the Desktop owns it.
experiments.refutes: No copy outside the disk image, which would mean the editor writes through a service per keystroke.

experiments.title: Calibrate the header word against the cursor
experiments.hypothesis: The 16-bit word at store offset 0x0000 is the insertion position, not the text length.
experiments.method: With a known 20-character text, press Home, then End, then move right one character at a time, saving and reading the file after each step.
experiments.expected: Word = 0 at Home, = 20 at End, and = position after each move, while the text bytes are unchanged.
experiments.refutes: A value that follows the text length rather than the cursor.

experiments.title: Clear: buffer or store?
experiments.hypothesis: Clear empties the live buffer and the store write is what makes it permanent.
experiments.method: Type text, save, Clear, then Escape without a further save and reopen the accessory.
experiments.expected: If the note returns, Clear touched only the buffer; if it stays empty, Clear wrote through.
experiments.refutes: A result that depends on how Escape is pressed rather than on whether a write occurred.

experiments.title: Insertion and deletion semantics
experiments.hypothesis: Insertion shifts the tail right and deletion shifts it left, with the header following the caret.
experiments.method: At a known offset k, insert one character, save, restore, then Backspace and Delete at the same k.
experiments.expected: A one-byte shift of the tail in each direction and a header equal to k or k-1.
experiments.refutes: Overwrite instead of insert, or a header that does not move.

experiments.title: Capacity boundary
experiments.hypothesis: The text area holds 2,860 bytes (2,864 minus the 4-byte header).
experiments.method: Paste or type progressively longer text and save at intervals around the boundary.
experiments.expected: Either a refusal message or truncation at a fixed byte count, with the file staying 2,864 bytes.
experiments.refutes: A file that grows, which would mean the store is not a fixed record.
preserve: file size and hash at each step

experiments.title: Where the file is actually opened
experiments.hypothesis: The Desktop, not the accessory, performs the DOS open/read/write for DMCORKBD.
experiments.method: Break on INT 21h AH=3Dh/3Fh/40h in the whole guest and on the far call to BBDA:8C18 from the accessory.
experiments.expected: The DOS calls occur in a different code segment from the accessory's, reached from the service call.
experiments.refutes: An open/read issued from the accessory's own segment.

experiments.title: Shared store, separate views
experiments.hypothesis: Corkboard, Note Pad and Information Center read the same store but keep independent views.
experiments.method: Edit in Information Center, leave it running, open Corkboard, and compare its text with the file.
experiments.expected: Either the same text (shared buffer) or the pre-edit text (per-application load).
experiments.refutes: A result that changes without an intervening save.

experiments.title: The unknown header word
experiments.hypothesis: The word at 0x0002 is a scroll offset or reserved space.
experiments.method: Type more lines than fit on screen, scroll to the end, save, and read the word.
experiments.expected: A non-zero value that tracks the first visible line, or zero if it is reserved.
experiments.refutes: A value that tracks the cursor, which would duplicate 0x0000.
preserve: first visible line from the framebuffer

experiments.title: Save timing
experiments.hypothesis: The store is written on close, not on every keystroke.
experiments.method: Type without closing, inspect the file, then close and inspect again.
experiments.expected: Unchanged file while editing; changed file after close.
experiments.refutes: A file that changes per keystroke.

experiments.title: Corrupted-note reproduction
experiments.hypothesis: The earlier corrupted note came from driving input without checking the store, not from the application.
experiments.method: Repeat the earlier failed sequence exactly, capturing the store before and after each input step.
experiments.expected: The divergence first appears at a store write, not at a screen update.
experiments.refutes: A divergence with no store write, which would move the fault into the application or the input path.

do_not: treat a static location as the runtime buffer without an observed address
publish guest memory dumps or full listings
modify the reserved worktree or emulator of the receiving campaign
